H6200.def: patronymically from «06177»; an Aroerite or inhabitant of Aroer:--Aroerite.

H6201.def: a primitive root; to droop; hence, to drip:--drop (down).

H6202.et: a primitive root [identical with (06201) through the idea of sloping]
H6202.def: a primitive root (identical with «06201» through the idea of sloping); properly, to bend downward; but used only as a denominative from «06203», to break the neck; hence (figuratively) to destroy:--that is beheaded, break down, break (cut off, strike off) neck.

H6203.def: from «06202»; the nape or back of the neck (as declining); hence, the back generally (whether literal or figurative):-- back ((stiff-)neck((-ed).

H6204.def: feminine of «06203»; mane; Orpah, a Moabites:--Orpah.

H6205.def: probably from «06201»; gloom (as of a lowering sky):--(gross, thick) dark (cloud, -ness).

H6206.def: a primitive root; to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass:--be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.

H6207.def: a primitive root; to gnaw, i.e. (figuratively) eat (by hyberbole); also (participle) a pain:--fleeing, sinew.

H6208.et: from an unused name meaning a tush
H6208.def: patrial from an unused name meaning a tush; an Arkite or inhabitant of Erek:--Arkite.

H6209.def: a primitive root; to bare; figuratively, to demolish:--make bare, break, raise up (perhaps by clerical error for raze), × utterly.

H6210.et: from an unused root meaning perhaps to arch
H6210.def: from an unused root meaning perhaps to arch; a couch (properly, with a canopy):--bed(-stead), couch.

H6212.et: from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green)
H6212.def: from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green); grass (or any tender shoot):--grass, herb.

H6213.def: a primitive root; to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application (as follows):--accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, × certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, + displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion, + feast, (fight-)ing man, + finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, + hinder, hold ((a feast)), × indeed, + be industrious, + journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, + officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, × sacrifice, serve, set

H6214.def: from «06213» and «0410»; God has made; Asahel, the name of four Israelites:--Asahel.

H6215.et: apparently a form of the pass. part. of (06213) in the original sense of handling
H6215.def: apparently a form of the passive participle of «06213» in the original sense of handling; rough (i.e. sensibly felt); Esav, a son of Isaac, including his posterity:--Esau.

H6217.def: or mashuq {aw-shook'}; passive participle of «06231»; used in plural masculine as abstractly, tyranny:--oppressed(-ion). (Doubtful.)

H6218.def: or masor {aw-sore'}; from «06235»; ten; by abbrev. ten strings, and so a decachord:--(instrument of) ten (strings, -th).

H6221.def: from «06213» and «0410»; made of God; Asiel, an Israelite:--Asiel.

H6222.def: from «06213» and «03050»; Jah has made; Asajah, the name of three or four Israelites:--Asaiah.

H6223.def: from «06238»; rich, whether literal or figurative (noble):--rich (man).

H6224.def: from «06235»; tenth; by abbreviation, tenth month or (feminine) part:--tenth (part).

H6225.def: a primitive root; to smoke, whether literal or figurative:--be angry (be on a) smoke.

H6227.def: from «06225»; smoke, literally or figuratively (vapor, dust, anger):--smoke(-ing).

H6228.def: the same as «06227»; Ashan, a place in Palestine:--Ashan.

H6229.def: a primitive root (identical with «06231»); to press upon, i.e. quarrel; --strive with.

H6231.def: a primitive root (compare «06229»); to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow:--get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress((-ion)), -or), do violence (wrong).

H6233.def: from «06231»; injury, fraud, (subjectively) distress, (concretely) unjust gain:--cruelly, extortion, oppression, thing (deceitfully gotten).

H6235.def: masculine of term aasarah {as-aw-raw'}; from «06237»; ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits):--ten, (fif-, seven-)teen.

H6236.def: (Aramaic) masculine aasrah (Aramaic). {as-raw'}; corresponding to «06235»; ten:--ten, + twelve.

H6237.def: a primitive root (ident. with «06238»); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from «06235»; to tithe, i.e. to take or give a tenth:--X surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), × truly.

H6238.def: a primitive root; properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich:--be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See «06240».

H6240.def: for «06235»; ten (only in combination), i.e. -teen; also (ordinal) -teenth:--(eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-)teen(-th), + eleven(-th), + sixscore thousand, + twelve(-th).

H6241.def: or oissaron {is-saw-rone'}; from «06235»; (fractional) a tenth part:--tenth deal.

H6244.def: a primitive root; probably to shrink, i.e. fail:--be consumed.

H6245.def: a primitive root; probably to be sleek, i.e. glossy; hence (through the idea of polishing) to excogitate (as if forming in the mind):--shine, think.

H6249.et: apparently masc. pl. construction of (06247) in the sense of an afterthought (used only in connection with (06240) in lieu of (259)) eleven or (ordinal) eleventh
H6249.def: apparently masculine plural construction of «06247» in the sense of an afterthought (used only in connection with «06240» in lieu of «0259») eleven or (ordinal) eleventh:--+ eleven(-th).

H6252.def: or bAshtaroth {ash-taw-roth'}; plural of «06251»; Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan:--Asharoth, Astaroth. See also «01045», «06253», «06255».

H6253.def: probably for «06251»; Ashtoreth, the Phoenician goddess of love (and increase):--Ashtoreth.

H6254.def: patrial from «06252»; an Ashterathite or inhabitant of Ashtaroth:--Ashterathite.

H6255.def: from «06252» and the dual of «07161»; Ashtaroth of (the) double horns (a symbol of the deity); Ashteroth-Karnaim, a place East of the Jordan:--Ashtoreth Karnaim.

H6256.def: from «05703»; time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.:--+ after, (al-)ways, × certain, + continually, + evening, long, (due) season, so (long) as, (even-, evening-, noon-)tide, ((meal-)), what) time, when.

H6257.def: a primitive root; to prepare:--make fit, be ready to become.

H6258.def: from «06256»; at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive:--henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas.

H6260.def: or sattud {at-tood'}; from «06257»; prepared, i.e. full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he-goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people:--chief one, (he) goat, ram.

H6262.def: for «06261»; Attai, the name of three Israelites:--Attai.

H6264.def: from «06257»; prepared; by implication, skilful; feminine plural the future; also treasure:--things that shall come, ready, treasures.

H6265.def: from «05790» and «03050»; Jah has helped; Athajah, an Israelite:--Athaiah.

H6266.def: from «06275»; properly, antique, i.e. venerable or splendid:--durable.

H6267.def: from «06275»; removed, i.e. weaned; also antique:--ancient, drawn.

H6269.et: from an unused root meaning to sojourn
H6269.def: from an unused root meaning to sojourn; lodging; Athak, a place in Palestine:--Athach.

H6270.et: from an unused root meaning to compress
H6270.def: from an unused root meaning to compress; constringent; Athlai, an Israelite:--Athlai.

H6271.def: or mAthalyahuw {ath-al-yaw'-hoo}; from the same as «06270» and «03050»; Jah has constrained; Athaljah, the name of an Israelitess and two Israelites:--Athaliah.

H6272.def: a primitive root; probably to glow, i.e. (figuratively) be desolated:--be darkened.

H6273.et: from an unused root meaning to force
H6273.def: from an unused root meaning to force; forcible; Othni, an Israelite:--Othni.

H6274.def: from the same as «06273» and «0410»; force of God; Othniel, an Israelite:--Othniel.

H6275.def: a primitive root; to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe:--copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove.

H6277.et: from (06275) in the sense of license
H6277.def: from «06275» in the sense of license; impudent:--arrogancy, grievous (hard) things, stiff.

H6278.def: from «06256» and «07011»; time of a judge; Eth-Katsin, a place in Palestine:--Ittah-kazin (by including directive enclitic).

H6279.def: a primitive root (rather denominative from «06281»); to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer):--intreat, (make) pray(-er).

H6280.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) abundant:--deceitful, multiply.

H6281.def: from «06280»; abundance; Ether, a place in Palestine:--Ether.

H6282.def: from «06280»; incense (as increasing to a volume of smoke); hence (from «06279») a worshipper:--suppliant, thick.

H6284.def: a primitive root; to puff, i.e. blow away:--scatter into corners.

H6285.def: feminine of «06311»; properly, mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction, region, extremity:--corner, end, quarter, side.

H6286.def: a primitive root; to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; denominative from «06288», to shake a tree:--beautify, boast self, go over the boughs, glorify (self), glory, vaunt self.

H6287.def: from «06286»; an embellishment, i.e. fancy head-dress:--beauty, bonnet, goodly, ornament, tire.

H6288.def: or pora'h {po-raw'}; or pu'rah {poo-raw'}; from «06286»; properly, ornamentation, i.e. (plural) foliage (including the limbs) as bright green:--bough, branch, sprig.

H6289.def: from «06286»; properly, illuminated, i.e. a glow; as noun, a flush (of anxiety):--blackness.

H6290.def: from «06286»; ornamental; Paran, a desert of Arabia:--Paran.

H6291.et: from an unused root meaning to be torpid, i.e. crude
H6291.def: from an unused root meaning to be torpid, i.e. crude; an unripe fig:--green fig.

H6292.et: from an unused root meaning to stink
H6292.def: or piggul {pig-gool'}; from an unused root meaning to stink; properly, fetid, i.e. (figuratively) unclean (ceremonially):--abominable(-tion, thing).

H6293.def: a primitive root; to impinge, by accident or violence, or (figuratively) by importunity:--come (betwixt), cause to entreat, fall (upon), make intercession, intercessor, intreat, lay, light (upon), meet (together), pray, reach, run.

H6295.def: from «06294» and «0410»; accident of God; Pagiel, an Israelite:--Pagiel.

H6296.def: a primitive root; to relax, i.e. become exhausted:--be faint.

H6297.def: from «06296»; a carcase (as limp), whether of man or beast; figuratively, an idolatrous image:--carcase, corpse, dead body.

H6298.def: a primitive root; to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence; figuratively, to concur:--meet (with, together).

H6299.def: a primitive root; to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve:--X at all, deliver, × by any means, ransom, (that are to be, let be) redeem(-ed), rescue, × surely.
